provenance_note: Every usd figure here is a CLIENT-SIDE ESTIMATE (Anthropic list-price token counts, or an SDK/self-reported query cost) -- NONE of it is a billed invoice. coverage="unknown" always means usd=null, never a silent zero; a real zero only appears when the underlying ledger was actually read and had nothing to report.

claude_code.method: live scan of Claude Code session transcripts, Anthropic list-price token estimate (spend_summary.py's own scanner, called directly)

groq.method: swarm-calls.jsonl tokens priced at Groq's published on-demand rate

conductor.method: self-reported cost_usd from conductor-outcomes.jsonl, corrected x2.16 (same factor conductor_budget.py's spend governor applies -- imported, not re-derived)

card_fire.method: SDK self-reported per-query cost, companion-ask-feed joined to companion-ask-results.jsonl origin=='card'

chat.method: SDK self-reported per-query cost, companion-ask-feed joined to companion-ask-results.jsonl origin in {chat,cockpit-chat,text,diagram,voice}

companion_other.method: SDK self-reported per-query cost, companion-ask-feed id with no origin match in companion-ask-results.jsonl (join gap, not zero spend)

other.method: other = claude_code_total - conductor - card_fire - chat - companion_other

sources.card_fire_and_chat: automation/state/companion-ask-feed/*.jsonl result frames (pruned to the 50 most-recently-completed asks repo-wide), joined by ask id to companion-ask-results.jsonl's origin tag
sources.companion_other: same feed, ask ids with no origin match in companion-ask-results.jsonl
sources.other: residual = claude_code total - conductor - card_fire - chat - companion_other (no distinct 'workflow' ledger exists on this box -- see module docstring)
